note: The checked DistSQL direct-unary path binds each logical region topology to one address-directed lazy dispatch and transits the pinned region-error outcomes through RegionCache. Known leaders resend immediately; scheduling and retry categories reserve typed delays; rebuild outcomes retain source order; terminal and unsupported outcomes close without probing future tasks. One budget per region ID is shared with TiDB's outer RegionMiss rebuild, and an injected sleeper makes pre-retry/sleep cancellation deterministic. Locks, generic connection retry, replica rotation, metrics, async dispatch, forwarding, and TLS remain external.
